result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with signalized crossings and green-painted bicycle infrastructure. While sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the excessive crossing distance and lack of median refuges create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings on the left side of the image are significantly faded, reducing visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to all legs of the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals, along with 'No Turn On Red' restrictions. However, the very wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island result in long crossing distances and high exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The geometry of the corners allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk with a curb ramp and tactile warning surface, supported by pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes create a significant crossing distance without a refuge island, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide lane geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk and a bus shelter, providing good pedestrian space. However, there is a lack of marked crosswalks or traffic control at a point where tactile paving suggests a crossing, creating exposure to uncontrolled traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing Point
hazards.description: Tactile paving indicates a crossing point, but there are no painted markings or signage to alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right, where the red tactile paving meets the road.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb may block sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility (continental) marked crosswalk to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs to increase driver awareness.
